+    p0, p1 = pair
+    # jump between occurrences of one pair element with list.index (in C) and
+    # copy the untouched runs between matches with slices; i = start of the
+    # not yet copied part, s = where the next search starts
+    k = ids.count(p0)
+    if not k:
+        return list(ids)
+    newids = []
+    extend = newids.extend
+    append = newids.append
+    index = ids.index
+    i = s = 0
+    if p0 != p1:
+        k1 = ids.count(p1)
+        if k1 < k:
+            # distinct elements: occurrences cannot overlap, so scanning the
+            # rarer second element finds exactly the same (left-to-right) matches
+            while k1:
